description: This is a Java class named PersonMapper that provides static methods for converting between data transfer objects (DTOs) and entity objects related to a person, as well as applying updates to entity objects.

classes.name: PersonMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for mapping between Person DTOs and Person entity objects, as well as applying updates to entities.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a PersonCreateRequest DTO into a PersonEntity.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a PersonEntity into a PersonResponse DTO.

methods.name: applyUpdate
methods.description: Applies update request DTO data to an existing PersonEntity.
